direction: Mineral white / petrol ink / ice cyan
principles: Retain v5 recording modules and minimal hierarchy
Use one accent family consistently across library and details
No decorative glow, colored blobs, gradients or marketing headings
Maintain text contrast on stable near-opaque reading surfaces

states.rest: Subtle boundary already visible; no hover-only affordance
states.hover: 140ms boundary and slight elevation; no content expansion
states.selected: AccentSoft or accent border, never both a strong fill and glow
states.currentTranscript: A quiet tint plus a short side indicator; retain timestamp and speaker
states.reducedMotion: No translate, no scroll-linked effects; immediate or opacity/color changes

icons.rationale: Regular icons give compact, balanced Apple-like geometry without using the thin weight that can become faint at 20px.
icons.implementation: Use official local SVG assets from the package; do not trace or hand-draw icons.
icons.buttonRules: Tooltip on hover and focus; accessible name; 44px targets. Keep file names, dates, speakers, timestamps, ETA and playback speed textual.

detailRules: Library and detail share background, toolbar, cards, icons and type ramp.
Return icon at left; filename and metadata identify the page; no generic Transcript header above obvious transcript.
Player has the same 44px icon controls and petrol timeline.
Use timestamp gutter + speaker control + text measure; active turn tint and click-to-seek.
Notes and questions stay secondary, via one compact tab or side panel; collapse on mobile.
Speaker candidates are explicitly pending; renaming a speaker and reassigning a single turn are separate scopes.
validationAdjustments: Tooltips hidden with display:none; visible hints align inward to avoid horizontal overflow
Detail transcript remains 16px; sidebar text at least14px
